interpretation: Across the fixed three-source roster, AutoEval supplies the strongest executable gate, UMI-Bench the richest declared scene schema, and RoboDojo the clearest human overlay workflow. None fixes the conjunction of a released object-state representation, numeric reset-acceptance tolerance, pre-execution decision linked to controller start, and source-owned adequacy basis.
p2_implication: The public systems provide useful reset mechanics and lifecycle patterns, but no externally justified numeric object-state acceptance tolerance. P2 should therefore use a site-feasibility interface with an explicit pair-conditioned target or a newly justified source-owned tolerance; coarse image similarity cannot be promoted into a generic reset rule.
